top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic twist angle, 2011) with an experimental discovery (correlated insulating and superconducting states, 2018) that the prediction did not guarantee; a single tuning knob now controls bandwidth and interaction strength, and independent groups have reproduced the phase diagram. The citation can be anchored on those two items without claiming a pairing mechanism. The open mechanism, the field's age and the incomplete credit (Yuan Cao, earlier twisted-bilayer theory) are real weaknesses but do not outweigh the secure observation. P002 is mature and cleanly credited to two names and is my fallback, but it is closer to a measurement capability than a discovery and follows the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes. A prize now is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No specific conflict is apparent from the profile for P001 or P002 (Chalmers/WACQT circuit QED work is unrelated to moire materials or optical clocks); the Chalmers and WACQT circuit-QED connection would matter only for B026, which is not on this slate.
